content.title: Taoping says Nasdaq grants additional 180 calendar day period for compliance
content.summary: Taoping (TAOP) announced that on December 19, it received notification from The Nasdaq Stock Market confirming the company has been granted an additional 180 calendar day period for compliance under its minimum bid price requirement through June 16, 2025.
